sources.title: Well-Pict — two strawberry labels in the March 2012 merchandising profile
sources.enumerated_scope: The two printed numeric variety labels in the Variety and Availability Guide paragraph on original PDF page 68. The Well-Pict-branded merchandising profile describes a 2011 supply development in its strawberry paragraph; it is not a current or lifetime portfolio.
sources.limitations: March 2012 historical commercial material, not independent cultivar authentication. The paragraph prints #3352 and #4053 without a denomination, breeder-code prefix or registry identifier. Keep both literal labels for review; do not infer a code prefix, alias, breeder, owner, licensee, current availability, release date or legal right. The profile's supply, performance and location wording remains an unreviewed company claim, not a verified trait or growing footprint. The generic field, food and pack photographs have no captions identifying either numeric label; no variety photo is assigned. The older current-site access gap remains open. The 2024 upload directory is not a publication date, and no exact publication day is invented.
review_warnings: Historical March 2012 profile describing 2011 supply; current varieties and availability are not established.
Numeric labels need identity review. No denomination, code prefix, alias or company role is approved.
